english.title: Driver of motor vehicle not in position to have full view - endorsable offence

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Road Vehicles Construction and Use Regulations 1986

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 104 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41D of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
